facts.business: Laxmi Goldorna House Limited is engaged in the jewellery division and real estate business.

auditor.name: J.S. Shah & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding fraud involving unauthorized diversion of funds by the CFO amounting to ₹87.20 lakhs, which has been written off.

key_risks: Fraud involving unauthorized diversion of funds by CFO
High intrinsic value and portable nature of inventory items leading to risk of theft or mala fide intent
High level of estimation involved in valuation of inventory, especially diamonds
facts.related_party_note: All transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act where applicable and details have been disclosed in the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
